entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕残句谓「向国王……有如下之言（bozes 即 voces）」，疑为陈情或效忠之套语
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 fragment: 'to the king ... has the following words (bozes = voces)'; probably a petition or oath formula
entries.notes: L 栏只剩残句，H/R 全空，无从定夺词义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（L 栏拼写与句读残乱，仅可辨 particular、llamada 等词，词目本身不明）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 (the Spanish line is badly garbled; only 'particular' and 'llamada' are legible, so the lemma itself is indeterminate)
entries.notes: L 栏内有脱字（p…ynda），M 栏音写亦无从对应

entries.zh: 回答；应声答话（responder 的副动词式，表「正在回答时」）
entries.en: answering; in reply (gerund of responder, 'while answering')

entries.zh: 发问；询问（preguntar 的副动词式，表「正在问时」）
entries.en: asking; inquiring (gerund of preguntar, 'while asking')

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（残句涉及「高声呼喊」（clamando），其余不可读）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 (the fragment mentions 'crying out' (clamando); the rest is illegible)
entries.notes: L 栏残断，M/H/R 三栏全空

entries.zh: 修道院院长；教长（abad 指隐修院首长，prelado 为高级教职之称）
entries.en: abbot; prelate (head of a monastery)

entries.zh: 犀牛（复数）；犀类
entries.en: rhinoceroses (plural of abada)

entries.zh: 犀牛（旧籍记其独角）；犀角
entries.en: rhinoceros (abada, said in old sources to have a single horn); rhinoceros horn
entries.notes: L 栏附注 uno corrio（疑即 un cuerno，一角），与 M 栏可对「犀牛」者互证

entries.zh: 鳕鱼（大口鳕，即 bacalao）；腌鳕鱼
entries.en: cod (bacalao; also pollack); salted cod
entries.notes: L 栏 baca lau 即 bacalau（bacalao，鳕鱼）之古写

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（词头疑为 abadesa，即女修道院院长；其后文字残乱不可读）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 (headword probably abadesa, 'abbess'; what follows is garbled beyond reading)
entries.notes: 词头 Abadesp 末字残缺，后半西文与 M 栏音写均不可解

entries.zh: 修道院（abadía）；教长之职、教长地位（prelacía）
entries.en: abbey; prelacy (office or dignity of a prelate)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏 abar…bar 不成词（疑与 varar、barra 一类海事词有关），M/H/R 全空

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（词头疑为 dejar，即「留下、离弃」）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 (headword probably a miswritten dejar, 'to leave, forsake')
entries.notes: Darjar 不成词，其后 ut abe rc 残断

entries.zh: 和解；讲和（avenir 的副动词式，指双方议和、言归于好时）
entries.en: reconciling; coming to terms (gerund of avenir)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（词头仅存 A…dore，不能定夺）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 (only 'A…dore' survives; the lemma cannot be determined)
entries.notes: 词头中段残缺，M 栏音写无从对应

entries.zh: 站住！止步！（呼喝令停）；高的、高处（alto 之另一义）
entries.en: halt! stop! (a call to stop); high, tall (the adjective's other sense)

entries.zh: 水流；水势（corriente）
entries.en: current, flow (of water)
entries.notes: L 栏 Ut 疑为 Vt.（＝vide，参见）之误写，非词目本身

entries.zh: 唐船（champán）上的圆球状构件（具体所指未详）
entries.en: round ball or fitting on a champán, a Chinese trading vessel (exact referent unclear)
entries.notes: champán 即往返吕宋与闽南的华人唐船；bola 所指实物（球饰或 borda 船舷之误）待考

entries.zh: 是绳子；绳索（cuerda 的另一义为「清醒、有理智」，女性形）
entries.en: it is a rope; cord (cuerda also means 'sane', feminine)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（词头 Al m…te 残断，不能定夺）
entries.en: 〔damaged original; gloss uncertain〕 (the headword survives only as 'Al m…te')
entries.notes: 词头残缺，M 栏音写无从对应
